New score (Twinkle example).description: A complete single-staff score — Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
body: // Relative octave (the default): each note sits in the octave nearest the
// previous one. Add ' to jump up an octave (the leap to G is g'), , to jump down (g,).
melody { c4 c g' g | a a g2 | f4 f e e | d d c2 | }
melody { |: g'4 g f f | e e d2 :| }
// structure replays sections in order: A, then B (repeated), then A again.

New score (grand staff / piano).description: A two-staff (piano) score — Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
body: // Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star (public domain) — piano.
// Relative octave: ' jumps up an octave (right hand g'), , jumps down
// (left hand c, drops to the low bass).
rh { c4 c g' g | a a g2 | f4 f e e | d d c2 | }
lh { c,2 g | c2 c | f2 c | g2 c | }
